name: pass-strengthindicator
title: Password Strength Indicator
blurb: Password input with a horizontal progress bar strength indicator and…
description: A password form with a horizontal progress bar that fills and changes color based on strength, and a permanent requirements checklist with check/cross icons.
use_when: When space allows always-visible requirements and a progress bar style strength indicator.
avoid_when: When space is limited or when dot/border color indicators are more appropriate.
a11y: Password input properly labeled, progress bar has role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max, requirements have aria-label.
